name: Inclusense Accessibility Widget
author: inclusense

sections.description:
The Inclusense Accessibility Widget helps website owners improve accessibility by adding a powerful, customizable accessibility widget to any WordPress website.

Simply install and activate the plugin. Once your website is connected to an active Inclusense subscription, the widget automatically loads on your website—no coding required.

Features

  • Custom widget trigger
  • Custom widget icon
  • Widget color customization
  • Show or hide individual accessibility tools
  • Screen reader support
  • High contrast mode
  • Visual adjustment tools
  • Multilingual language support
  • Lightweight asynchronous loading

Why Choose Inclusense?

  • Install in less than one minute.
  • No code changes required.
  • Manage everything from a single dashboard.
  • Customize your widget without updating WordPress.
  • Works with any modern WordPress theme.
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly.
  • Regular updates and new accessibility features.

Manage Everything from the Inclusense Dashboard

After connecting your website, you can manage all widget settings from your Inclusense dashboard, including:

  • Widget colors
  • Widget icon
  • Custom trigger
  • Widget position
  • Show or hide accessibility tools
  • Website management
  • Accessibility settings

Start your 14-day free trial (no credit card required) or manage your subscription:

https://inclusense.eu

Note: The plugin is free to install. An active Inclusense subscription is required to display and manage the accessibility widget.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide accessibility functionality.

Inclusense Widget Service

Purpose

Loads and manages the Inclusense Accessibility Widget for your website.

Script Loaded

https://embed.inclusense.eu/script.js

How it works

  • The plugin asynchronously loads the Inclusense widget.
  • The widget securely connects to the Inclusense API.
  • Your website domain is validated before the widget is displayed.
  • Widget settings are downloaded from your Inclusense dashboard.
  • Unauthorized domains cannot load the widget.

Privacy Policy:

https://inclusense.eu/privacy-policy

Google Translate

Used to provide multilingual language support within the accessibility widget.

Privacy Policy:

https://policies.google.com/privacy

Browser Features

The Inclusense Accessibility Widget uses browser-native accessibility APIs including:

  • Speech Synthesis API
  • Keyboard navigation enhancements
  • High contrast support
  • Visual adjustment features
  • Browser translation support
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Visit https://inclusense.eu and create your Inclusense account.
  3. Add your website to your Inclusense dashboard.
  4. Configure your widget colors, icon, trigger and accessibility settings.
  5. Save your settings.

The accessibility widget will automatically appear on your website.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes.

The WordPress plugin is completely free to install.

An active Inclusense subscription is required to activate and manage the accessibility widget.

Where can I purchase a subscription?

Visit:

https://inclusense.eu

You can start a 14-day free trial with no credit card required or purchase a subscription.

Do I need to edit my website code?

No.

Simply install and activate the plugin. All widget settings are managed from your Inclusense dashboard.

Can I customize the widget?

Yes.

You can customize:

  • Widget colors
  • Widget icon
  • Custom widget trigger
  • Widget position
  • Show or hide accessibility tools
  • Accessibility settings

All customization is managed from your Inclusense dashboard.

Does the plugin affect website performance?

No.

The widget loads asynchronously and is designed to have minimal impact on website performance.

Website Integration & Setup – Install the plugin, copy the embed script, and manage your website integration.
